name: headshot-haven
description: Browser FPS aim trainer: 3D Three.js arena, reaction and CPS tests, MERN leaderboards.

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend
